name: Gopa Bhattacharjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Gopa Bhattacharjee is a bilingual poet and entrepreneur from Kolkata. Her English collections include Unturned Verses and Thirty Birds. Her literary activity also includes interviewing fellow writers: in IPPL Journal, she speaks with Lopamudra Banerjee about poetry, collaboration and translation.

Her poems in Kabita Live explore moments when an inner voice confronts loss or resistance. ‘Transient’ brings sleeplessness, memory and winter into a brief recognition of impermanence. ‘The Soliloquy’ draws on Shakespearean figures and a phoenix image to move from betrayal and doubt towards renewed courage.
